propositions: Changing a ticket's type while keeping the plan materially identical causes plan-review to incorrectly reuse the stored verdict computed under the old type's criteria
The material_fingerprint hash excludes ticket_type and so reuse predicates in both idempotent_reuse and verdict_reuse never detect type changes
A plan that passes as a bug (exempt from certain criteria) keeps that pass verdict when retyped to task (not exempt), even though it would fail under task-specific criteria
The stored REVIEW_RESULT sidecar already contains ticket_type but it is never read by the reuse functions to validate whether the stored type matches the current type

The fix adds type comparison guards to both reuse paths that return None (forcing a full re-review) when stored and current types differ and both are truthy, while preserving reuse for sidecars with absent or empty types
